grammarFocus: 第一条件句；because / therefore；情态动词建议。
title: A Community Garden Meeting
instructions: 阅读下面的短文，回答10个问题。短文是关于一个社区花园会议的模拟场景。请仔细阅读，然后完成选择题、填空题和判断题。填空题的答案必须来自原文，且不超过字数限制。所有解释均为中文。
passage:
Last week, the Green Street community held a meeting about a new garden. Many people came because they want a clean and beautiful place. The garden will be on an old parking lot. The city said, "If we work together, we can change this place."

At the meeting, people talked about problems. First, there is too much rubbish. Second, there are not enough trees. Therefore, the group made a plan. They will clean the lot every Saturday. They will also plant ten trees. If they plant trees, the air will be better. Because trees give oxygen, everyone will feel healthier.

Some people had questions. One man asked, "Will there be a place for children?" The leader said, "Yes, we will build a small playground." Another woman said, "I am worried about water." The leader answered, "We will collect rainwater. If it rains, we will save water for the plants."

The group needs volunteers. You should join if you have time. You must bring gloves and a hat. You should not bring dogs. If you want to help, come on Saturday morning at 9 o'clock. Because many people are interested, the first meeting is very important. Therefore, please arrive early.

The garden will open in June. If everyone helps, the garden will be a success. The community is excited because they are working together.

questions.prompt: Why did many people come to the meeting?
options: Because they want a clean and beautiful place.
Because they want to buy the parking lot.
Because they want to build a school.
Because they want to meet the mayor.
answers: Because they want a clean and beautiful place.
questions.explanation: 原文第一段说：'Many people came because they want a clean and beautiful place.' 因此选项A正确。
questions.evidence: Many people came because they want a clean and beautiful place.

questions.prompt: What will happen if they plant trees?
options: The parking lot will be smaller.
The children will have a playground.
The city will give them money.
questions.explanation: 原文第二段说：'If they plant trees, the air will be better.' 因此选项A正确。
questions.evidence: If they plant trees, the air will be better.

questions.prompt: What does the leader say about water?
options: They will buy water from the city.
They will use water from the river.
questions.explanation: 原文第三段中，领导者说：'We will collect rainwater.' 因此选项A正确。
原文第四段说：'You must bring gloves and a hat.' 因此选项A正确。
questions.evidence: You must bring gloves and a hat.

questions.prompt: What time should volunteers come on Saturday morning? (Use one word and a number from the text.)
questions.explanation: 原文第四段说：'come on Saturday morning at 9 o'clock.' 因此答案是'9 o'clock'。
questions.evidence: come on Saturday morning at 9 o'clock.

questions.prompt: What will the group build for children? (Use two words from the text.)
questions.explanation: 原文第三段说：'we will build a small playground.' 因此答案是'small playground'。
questions.evidence: we will build a small playground.

questions.prompt: What is the main idea of the second paragraph?
options: The problems and the plan to solve them.
The history of the parking lot.
The importance of trees for children.
The cost of the garden project.
answers: The problems and the plan to solve them.
questions.explanation: 第二段先提到问题（垃圾太多、树不够），然后说'Therefore, the group made a plan.' 并说明计划内容，因此主旨是问题和解决计划。
questions.evidence: First, there is too much rubbish. Second, there are not enough trees. Therefore, the group made a plan.

questions.prompt: True or False or Not Given: The garden will open in July.
questions.explanation: 原文最后一段说：'The garden will open in June.' 因此'在七月开放'是错误的。
questions.evidence: The garden will open in June.

questions.prompt: True or False or Not Given: The meeting was held in the parking lot.
questions.explanation: 原文没有说明会议在哪里举行。只提到花园将建在旧停车场，但没有说会议地点。因此是Not Given。

questions.prompt: True or False or Not Given: Volunteers should not bring dogs.
questions.explanation: 原文第四段说：'You should not bring dogs.' 因此'志愿者不应该带狗'是正确的。

vocabulary.example: The Green Street community held a meeting.
The garden will be a success.

grammar.title: 第一条件句；because / therefore；情态动词建议
grammar.explanation: 第一条件句表示如果某事发生，就会有某种结果，结构是'If + 一般现在时，主语 + will + 动词原形'。because 表示原因，therefore 表示结果。情态动词 should 表示建议，must 表示必须。
grammar.example: If they plant trees, the air will be better.

questions.prompt: If it rains tomorrow, we ___ at home.
questions.explanation: 第一条件句中，主句用 will + 动词原形，表示将来结果。
questions.evidence: If it rains tomorrow, we will stay at home.

questions.prompt: She was tired, ___ she went to bed early.
questions.explanation: therefore 表示结果，这里'累了'是原因，'早睡'是结果。
questions.evidence: She was tired, therefore she went to bed early.

questions.prompt: You ___ bring your book to class. It is necessary.
questions.explanation: must 表示必须，should 表示建议。这里说'这是必要的'，所以用 must。
questions.evidence: You must bring your book to class.

questions.prompt: ___ you study hard, you will pass the exam.
questions.explanation: 第一条件句用 If 引导条件，表示'如果你努力学习，你就会通过考试'。
questions.evidence: If you study hard, you will pass the exam.

part1: Do you like gardens? Why or why not?
What do you do to keep your neighborhood clean?

speaking.part2: Describe a community project you would like to join. You should say: what the project is; where it is; who can join; and explain why you want to join it.
part3: Why is it important to have gardens in cities?
What are the benefits of volunteering?
How can governments encourage people to protect the environment?
Do you think individual actions can make a big difference? Why?

transfer.writing: Write a short paragraph (about 80-100 words) about a plan to improve your school or workplace. Use first conditional sentences, because/therefore, and modal verbs for suggestions.
